source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Enable AMDGPU RAS, require zero UMC count, inject device 0/block 0 with `-s 3 -t 4 -m 1`, observe hardware error and nonzero UMC count.
procedure_facts: Prose calls it ODECC correctable error at address 0x800, but the shown amdgpuras command contains no explicit address.
Uses `modprobe amdgpu ras_enable=1`; five-minute attended/machine time.
criteria_facts: Tool reports success, dmesg hardware error and post-query UMC count nonzero.
source_conflicts: Title says Replay AC Parity, procedure says ODECC correctable at 0x800, and the opaque command parameters do not expose address/error-type semantics.
missing_source_information: Vendor mapping for every flag/error subtype/address, stable GPU mapping, driver load/RAS support state, expected CE counter delta/message and recovery/cleanup.

original_test_intent.statement: Inject the platform-approved AMD UMC replay AC parity/correctable event into one specifically identified GPU and prove the expected UMC counter and kernel RAS handling response.
must_preserve: UMC target, source `-d 0 -b 0 -s 3 -t 4 -m 1`, zero pre-count requirement, success/dmesg/nonzero post-count and five-minute activity.
must_not_infer: Flag meanings or address 0x800 from prose alone.
Tool device 0 as a stable physical GPU.
Generic hardware-error text or any nonzero count as proof of the exact injected event.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 requires vendor-confirmed parameters, dedicated SUT/OOB, zero baseline, exact command, success/dmesg/nonzero count and recovery.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not classify the title/prose/opaque-command mismatch as SOURCE_CONFLICT, distinguish pre-existing/correctable/uncorrectable count deltas, or note that `modprobe ... ras_enable=1` may not apply options to an already loaded driver and could imply a disruptive reload.

related_records: Generic AMD UMC CE injection documentation cannot map this vendor tool's replay AC parity flags.
applicable_history.precedence_application: Source command is preserved but cannot execute until FAE maps its opaque flags to the named event/address and exact GPU.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: No injection until AMD/FAE reconciles Replay AC Parity versus ODECC CE/address and maps every amdgpuras flag and device index. Verify existing RAS enablement without blind driver reload, then require an event-specific counter delta and correlated kernel message.

conditions_present: Exact opaque command, nominal target/block, pre/post checks and five-minute plan.
missing: Flag/address/error mapping, stable GPU/card map, supported ASIC/driver/tool, RAS state/change procedure, expected CE/UE delta/message, persistence/recovery and approval.
provider: AMD/FAE supplies signed tool semantics and supported recipe.
Platform owner maps target GPU and approves dedicated SUT/recovery.
safe_read_only_work: Collect GPU UUID/BDF/card/render/tool/driver/firmware, RAS mask/features/counts, module parameters, workloads and baseline logs without loading/reloading/injecting.
prohibited_until_resolved: modprobe/reload, RAS state change, injection, counter clearing/EEPROM reset, reboot, log clearing or PASS.
closure_evidence: Signed event/flag/address/GPU map, expected CE/UE delta/message and approved state-change/recovery plan.

revision_candidate.test_name: Validate AMD UMC Replay AC Parity Error Injection
revision_candidate.purpose: Inject the FAE-defined UMC replay AC parity/correctable event into one stable, dedicated AMD GPU and verify the exact expected UMC CE/UE counter delta and correlated kernel RAS response without confusing a generic hardware error with the requested event.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact supported AMD GPU ASIC, firmware, amdgpu driver and pinned `amdgpuras` release whose owner documentation maps `-s 3 -t 4 -m 1` and address semantics to the named UMC event.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One dedicated GPU mapped from physical slot/UUID/BDF/DRM card to tool device 0 and UMC block 0. One approved injection in the five-minute activity; no other GPU/block/event and no counter reset.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Signed FAE mapping for title/event, correctable versus uncorrectable type, address 0x800 and every command flag; tool/driver/ASIC support; stable device/card map; RAS mask/features and enable procedure; required zero baseline and expected CE/UE delta/message; workload drain; OOB, reboot/driver recovery and explicit approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture stable GPU mapping, module/RAS features/mask, separate UMC CE/UE baseline counts and timestamped kernel/SEL logs. If amdgpu is already loaded, do not assume `modprobe ... ras_enable=1` changes it; follow only the vendor-approved RAS enable/state procedure, including any separately authorized drain/reload/reboot. Require the source zero baseline or stop without clearing it. After approval, run exactly `amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -s 3 -t 4 -m 1` under the signed event/address mapping once. Preserve tool output/status, query separate post CE/UE counts, correlate the exact delta and kernel message by time/device/event, then verify GPU/driver/PCIe health.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Source conflict resolved; supported dedicated idle SUT; stable mapping and zero baseline; RAS state proven; exact expected result/recovery and OOB approval ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: ASIC/GPU UUID/BDF/slot/DRM/tool-device map; driver/firmware/tool versions; signed flag/event/address semantics; module/RAS mask/features and enable state; pre/post separate UMC CE/UE raw counts and delta; exact command/output/status/time; event-specific dmesg/syslog/SEL messages; GPU reset/XGMI/PCIe/thermal health; recovery actions and final state.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: AMD/FAE recipe for the exact ASIC/tool/driver. Pass requires source zero baseline, tool success, the declared counter type increasing by the expected delta only on the target, a device/time/event-correlated kernel RAS message, and healthy recovery; generic nonzero or generic hardware-error text is insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not guess flags/address/error type, trust device index without mapping, reload driver via modprobe blindly, inject production/busy GPUs, clear counters/EEPROM/logs to obtain zero, repeat injection, accept unrelated CE/UE/message or reboot without approval.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: AMD/FAE approves semantics; platform owner approves target, any RAS/driver state change, injection and recovery; operator supervises OOB.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Agent may collect and run exact signed procedure; opaque semantic mapping and fault disposition remain vendor/engineering decisions.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On mapping/state/injection mismatch, unexpected UE/reset/XGMI/PCIe fault, hang or persistent count/error, stop, preserve all evidence, use approved OOB/driver/reboot recovery once, verify every GPU/host path and escalate before retry.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved event/flag/address conflict; unstable GPU mapping; unsupported RAS/tool/ASIC; nonzero required baseline; missing recovery/approval; command rejection; wrong/no counter delta; unexpected UE or wrong device; reset/hang/link fault; missing correlated message; unhealthy final state.

identified_defects: Replay AC Parity, ODECC CE and address/flags are not reconciled.
Tool index is not tied to physical GPU.
Generic nonzero/dmesg evidence is not event-specific.
modprobe may imply ineffective or disruptive driver-state handling.
reason_for_change: Prevent a real fault injection with guessed semantics or wrong GPU and make the expected RAS response an attributable delta rather than generic nonzero evidence.

new_technical_evidence.title: Linux Kernel AMDGPU RAS Support
new_technical_evidence.version: Linux 6.2 documentation; installed kernel/driver behavior must be verified
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Generic AMDGPU RAS support, not proprietary amdgpuras flag mapping
new_technical_evidence.supports: RAS support must be checked per block/ASIC; UMC correctable and uncorrectable counts are separate; error injection is state-changing and count deltas are the standard result evidence.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Replay AC parity, amdgpuras flags and address mapping require AMD/FAE documentation.

removed_ambiguities: Maps tool index to stable GPU identity.
Separates CE/UE counters and requires exact delta/correlated message.
resolved_blockers: Once vendor semantics and recovery are supplied, the bounded injection is automatable; missing package/approval alone is not permanent BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: Vendor flag/event/address mapping and safe RAS state/recovery remain unresolved.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 promotes the title/prose/opaque-command mismatch to SOURCE_CONFLICT, prevents ineffective/disruptive modprobe handling, and replaces generic nonzero evidence with a stable-device, CE/UE-specific expected delta plus correlated kernel event.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator independently retained the unresolved event/flag/address conflict, stable GPU mapping, no blind module reload, one injection, separate CE/UE delta, correlated kernel evidence and strict stop gates.
